note: Company marks shown beside company names. Edit, then run: node scripts/make-logos.mjs. Marks are trademarks of their owners, shown only to identify the source, never altered or recoloured.

svgl.release: main of https://github.com/pheralb/svgl, static/library (the logos belong to their owners; svgl's code is MIT)

simpleIcons.licence: CC0-1.0 icon files, filled with each brand's own colour

Amazon.note: svgl has no Amazon.com mark and Simple Icons removed Amazon and AWS (no confirmed permission). This is the AWS mark: both credits under Amazon are Amazon-owned, and the Builders' Library credit is AWS.

CrowdStrike.note: The Falcon symbol from CrowdStrike's own brand page (crowdstrike.com/about-us/brand/, CS-Logos-SVG.zip), black for the light theme and white for the dark one, originals unaltered in content/logo-sources. The copy drops the XML prolog and editor comment and crops the viewBox to the drawn shape; the drawing is untouched.

Discord.note: Discord's branding page asks for permission before uses it does not list, and a sources list is not one of them. Shown at the owner's decision; remove this entry if Discord objects.

hunter.about: Last resort for a company neither svgl nor Simple Icons has: https://logos.hunter.io/<domain>, no key, trademarks stay with their owners. Raster, so it is trimmed and saved as WebP; check it on both themes.
